decisions.reason: Although it may support partnerships and innovation, an accelerator program is peripheral to our core machinery-and-plant business and likely does not justify continued resource use versus focusing on scalable recycling systems.
A bio-based bitumen binder sits too far from our main business of modular recycling equipment and advisory services, making it a weaker strategic fit than our plant technologies.
An infectious waste decontamination plant is closely aligned with our decentralized waste-treatment technology platform and expands our addressable market within specialized waste processing.
A mobile mechanical recycling plant fits our core offering very well by delivering modular, site-specific recycling capacity for customers seeking decentralized treatment solutions.
